EmailTemplate.subject: ACTION REQUIRED: Update Flywire IPs
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
As a user of Flywire’s Gateway and/or SFTP services, we would like to inform you that Flywire will begin the use of new outbound IPs on 24th February 2020. These new IPs, which can be found here <[[https://flywire.box.com/s/sey7b494lf2er0hoenlmflnbjccv82or?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> (https://flywire.box.com/s/sey7b494lf2er0hoenlmflnbjccv82or <[[https://flywire.box.com/s/sey7b494lf2er0hoenlmflnbjccv82or?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>), will replace all existing Flywire IPs.
Please note that these new IPs will be utilized for both Demo/Staging and Production environments.
To help ensure that you don’t experience service disruption, please follow the action below:
ACTION REQUIRED: check with your IT / technical team(s) to see if your institution whitelists Flywire IPs for any services
- If so, please ensure that the above IPs <[[https://flywire.box.com/s/sey7b494lf2er0hoenlmflnbjccv82or?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> are appropriately whitelisted for your production and staging environments by 24th February 2020. Please note that all existing IPs will be depreciated on 24th March 2020. - If you don’t whitelist Flywire IPs, you do not need to take any action.
If you have any questions or need additional information, please contact solutions@flywire.com <[[mailto:solutions@flywire.com?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> and the team will be happy to assist.
